fulltext: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，奢侈定制厂商 Caviar 上月（2026 年 10 月）推出“世界珍宝”（World Treasures）系列后，本月（11 月）再次推出“十二星座”（Zodiac）系列，同样基于苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo 上改造，将其变为可按星座、材质与工艺自由搭配的奢华收藏品。
Caviar 表示“十二星座”系列并非固定成品，潜在用户可以通过在线配置，先选择十二星座之一，再对边框、后盖、星座图案及中央徽章等部位进行个性化定制。
在材质方面，Caviar 提供银色、镀金以及黑色 PVD 涂层钛金属边框；后盖则可选锻造碳纤维，或小牛皮、蟒蛇皮、鳄鱼皮等多种皮革。星座图案和背景装饰还可加入施华洛世奇水晶、珠宝珐琅或陨石镶嵌，并支持巴黎钉纹、人字纹等金属纹理工艺。
价格因配置差异而明显浮动。默认版摩羯座机型采用黑色钛金属边框与锻造碳纤维背板，预估售价为 14,800 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 98,901 元人民币）；水瓶座版本则使用银色与海军蓝鳄鱼皮，预估售价达 18,615 美元（现汇率约合 12.4 万元人民币）。所有基础配置均配备 256GB 存储空间。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，印度正加快建设本土半导体产业，计划在未来约 24 个月内研发出自主 GPU 芯片，同时推动基于 RISC-V 架构的 SHAKTI 和 VEGA 处理器进入商业市场。
据印度科技媒体 ETGovernment 当地时间 11 月 4 日报道，印度电子和信息技术部（MeitY）秘书长 S. Krishnan 在接受采访时透露，根据印度半导体使命 2.0，政府计划支持本土 GPU 芯片研发。
他表示，这项工作不可能一蹴而就，预计需要约 24 个月，印度将朝着拥有自主 GPU 的目标推进。不过，这一 GPU 项目目前仍处于早期规划阶段。Krishnan 没有透露具体负责研发的企业、芯片供应商或制造商，也没有公布芯片架构、性能指标及制程等技术细节。
Krishnan 还介绍了印度发展 AI 产业所需的五个基础层面，分别是能源供应、加速器芯片、计算基础设施与服务器、AI 模型以及应用。
据介绍，印度企业 VVDN、Kaynes 和 Avalon 已经具备服务器制造能力，印度高级计算发展中心（C-DAC）则开发了 Rudra 系列服务器，其中包括面向 AI 工作负载的产品，并通过技术转让帮助当地企业扩大生产。
除了 GPU，印度政府也计划推动本土 SHAKTI 和 VEGA 处理器商业化。两者均采用开放的 RISC-V 指令集架构，属于 CPU 设计，与此次规划中的 GPU 芯片是不同项目。采用 RISC-V 架构意味着本土开发者可以在不依赖专有 CPU 指令集架构授权的情况下设计处理器。
这两项处理器计划已经推进多年。印度理工学院马德拉斯分校（IIT Madras）于 2019 年发布 SHAKTI 软件开发工具包，让开发者能够在处理器商业化之前着手开发相关应用。2024 年推出的 Aries 3.0 开发板则搭载了 C-DAC 的 VEGA ET301 处理器。
VEGA ET301 是一款 32 位芯片，最高运行频率为 100MHz，配备 26KB SRAM，主要面向传感器、可穿戴设备和物联网等相对简单的应用场景，并非面向桌面 PC 或高强度图形计算任务。
在实际应用方面，印度政府于 9 月 26 日举行的 SEMICOM India 活动上展示了多个采用 SHAKTI 和 VEGA 处理器的项目，包括基于 SHAKTI 的自主水面清洁机器人、搭载 VEGA 处理器的数字望远镜，以及用于监测森林环境的 VEGA 项目。
印度电子和信息技术部还通过设计关联激励计划（DLI）扶持本土芯片设计企业。该部门表示，已有 24 家企业获得相关计划支持，并在此后获得风险投资或其他私人投资。这些企业涉及微控制器、无人机飞行控制器、智能电表芯片和闭路电视摄像头等产品。
在半导体制造方面，印度也在引入国际企业参与本土产业建设。印度总理府此前公布的信息显示，塔塔电子已与荷兰半导体设备制造商 ASML 达成合作，为印度古吉拉特邦多莱拉（Dholera）的首座前端半导体晶圆厂提供支持。英特尔也已宣布与塔塔集团建立战略合作关系，涉及印度市场的半导体制造和封装业务。
在 AI 对就业市场的影响方面，Krishnan 将当前机遇与 2000 年前后的 Y2K 问题相提并论。他认为，AI 可能为印度 IT 服务业带来类似的增长机会，不过具体业务形态将有所不同。印度企业可以帮助全球公司将 AI 技术整合进现有业务系统，提供数据安全、系统集成和企业级部署等服务。
印度国家转型委员会（NITI Aayog）此前发布的一份研究报告估计，印度 IT 及 IT 支持服务行业目前约有 600 万名从业人员。随着 AI 技术改变行业结构，约 200 万个现有岗位可能被淘汰，但与此同时，行业也可能新增约 400 万个岗位。Krishnan 认为，企业级 AI 应用落地将成为印度 IT 服务业新的业务增长方向。
印度政府希望通过 India Semiconductor Mission 2.0，逐步建立覆盖芯片设计、晶圆制造、先进封装、半导体材料、制造设备和研发的完整产业生态。
根据印度电子和半导体协会（IESA）此前发布的数据，印度半导体市场规模目前已超过 500 亿美元，预计到 2030 年将接近 1,000 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6,682.52 亿元人民币）。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据中国蓝新闻、第一财经日报报道，在本周的 2026 世界互联网大会乌镇峰会上，搜狐创始人、董事局主席兼首席执行官张朝阳坦言，承认自己“错过移动互联网”。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据新华社报道，11 月 5 日，国家广播电视总局相关负责人在京重申，关于真人微短剧与 AI 微短剧的关系，总局的态度十分明确：扶持真人剧，规范 AI 剧。
当日举行的 2026 中国广播电视精品创作大会微短剧论坛上，这位负责人表示，对微短剧而言，AI 带来的不只是创作环节的降本增效，更是生产方式、产业形态、发展逻辑的系统性变革。从剧本创作到拍摄制作，从传播分发到出海运营，全链条都在重塑，新的创作模式、新的产业生态正在孕育，全行业要善于把握、善于运用，让 AI 当好精品创作的帮手、创新发展的引擎。
“技术本身没有价值观，有价值观的，是使用技术的人。”该负责人说，深度伪造、侵权搬运、以假乱真，损害的不仅是作品，更是整个行业的信誉；必须统筹发展和安全，既发挥其所长，又规范其所短，始终坚持智能向善、趋利避害，筑牢底线、划清边界，决不能让劣币驱逐良币。
这位负责人称，AI 能生成画面，不能生成生活；能辅助创作，不能完全代替思考。微短剧的灵魂，终究来自人的情感、人的创造。要坚持以人为本，让技术服务于人，而不是让人被技术裹挟。
“扶持真人剧，就是坚定人的创造、人的情感、人的表演在微短剧中的主体地位，在资金、算法、评优上给予实实在在的支持；规范 AI 剧，不是不发展，而是要稳量提质，必须把握好 AI 的边界，版权底线、伦理底线必须守住。”他说。
该负责人表示，各平台必须压实主体责任，坚决落实“凡播必审、全量人审”，把好上线关口；切实优化算法，坚决纠治诱导沉迷的机制设计。总局对 AI 洗稿、盗版翻拍、未经授权使用肖像声音等侵权行为将持续加大打击力度。
IT之家注意到，广电总局今年 9 月公布数据，全国微短剧用户已超 8 亿，2025 年市场规模突破千亿元。今年前 8 个月，上线微短剧 43 万部，是去年全年的 13 倍，其中 AI 剧占比超九成，主要是人工智能技术在微短剧创作中得以广泛应用。AI 技术为微短剧降本增效、创新表达打开了新空间，同时也带来权益保护、内容质量等新挑战。
关于真人微短剧与 AI 微短剧的关系，广电总局网络视听节目管理司负责人曾在 9 月 17 日举行的国新办发布会上表示：
真人剧是精品创作的主力，要大力扶持。深入实施“微短剧精品创作传播计划”，指导平台开设“真人剧”专区，拿出真金白银来扶持，让好作品有市场、有回报。
AI 剧发展很快、占比很高，坚持鼓励创新与守住底线并重，要求 AI 剧打上内容标注，推动平台严守肖像、声音授权底线，全流程把关。归根结底，AI 是工具，人是创作的主体。AI 剧发展越快，越要把好内容关。

cards.title: Samsung One UI 9.5 brings notable changes to Health and Calendar
cards.title_cn: Samsung One UI 9.5 为健康和日历带来显着变化
cards.summary: 【Android Authority】TL;DR Early One UI 9.5 test builds reveal upcoming changes to Samsung Calendar and Samsung Health. Samsung Calendar is getting a cleaner, grid-free interface, a relocated search button, and a new Key…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Samsung’s One UI 9 rollout is still underway, but that isn’t stopping the South Korean tech giant from preparing its next big software update. With One UI 9.5 currently in development, and an early beta build for the Galaxy S26 Ultra already spotted on a test server, we’re starting to inch closer to Samsung’s second Android 17-based update.
Samsung hasn’t detailed what’s coming with the update, but that hasn’t stopped testers from getting their hands on the unreleased software and uncovering the changes.
The latest discoveries shed light on two first-party apps: Samsung Health and Samsung Calendar, both of which appear to be getting some love with One UI 9.5, as highlighted by SamMobile.
The image on the left highlights what Google Calendar looks like with One UI 9, while the image on the right highlights what it could look like with One UI 9.5.

There are three main notable changes here. For starters, Samsung appears to have removed the individual rectangular backgrounds surrounding each date, so instead of appearing against a contrasting cell, dates now simply float against a black background. This makes the boundaries between dates much less obvious. At the same time, it gives the view a lot more room to breathe.

Secondly, the search button has been relocated from the top right of the view to the bottom right, sitting right next to the Add event pill. Speaking of which, the pill itself now surfaces less text. It only says “Add event” without referencing the currently selected date.

Elsewhere, the search screen now also appears to highlight a new Key events section, which reportedly displays important events as pill-shaped shortcuts. As seen in the second screenshot above, the section will appear above the existing calendar and color menus. And as seen in the last image above, the app’s sidebar is being reorganized too. The Sync now, Recycle bin, and Settings options now appear to have been relocated above the account list.

The updated Samsung Health offers some UI changes, but the bigger addition here is Mindful note, a new in-app journaling feature. The addition aims to offer Samsung users a safe place to reflect, note down thoughts, and “capture a moment, a feeling, or whatever comes to mind.”

You have the option to start with a blank slate or get some ideas with prompts, including About yourself, Relationships, Work and goals, and What if…? There’s also an option to set reminders, which should come in handy if you’re trying to make journaling a daily habit.
The changes mentioned above have only been spotted in prerelease software. These might never make it out widely, and if they do, they might or might not look and function as described here.

fulltext_cn: Android Authority 上的附属链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解更多。
2026 年 11 月 5 日 — 下午 5:09（美国东部时间）
三星 One UI 9 的推出仍在进行中，但这并没有阻止这家韩国科技巨头准备下一次重大软件更新。目前 One UI 9.5 正在开发中，并且 Galaxy S26 Ultra 的早期 Beta 版本已经在测试服务器上发现，我们距离三星第二次基于 Android 17 的更新越来越近了。
三星尚未详细说明更新的内容，但这并没有阻止测试人员接触未发布的软件并发现变化。
最新发现揭示了两款第一方应用程序：三星健康和三星日历，正如 SamMobile 强调的那样，这两款应用程序似乎都受到 One UI 9.5 的青睐。
左图突出显示了 Google 日历在 One UI 9 中的外观，右图则突出显示了 One UI 9.5 中的 Google 日历的外观。
这里有三个主要的显着变化。首先，三星似乎已经删除了每个日期周围的单独矩形背景，因此日期现在只是漂浮在黑色背景上，而不是出现在对比鲜明的单元格上。这使得日期之间的界限变得不那么明显。同时，它也给了景观更多的呼吸空间。
其次，搜索按钮已从视图的右上角移至右下角，位于“添加事件”药丸旁边。说到这里，药丸本身现在显示的文字更少了。它只说“添加事件”，而不引用当前选择的日期。
在其他地方，搜索屏幕现在似乎还突出显示了一个新的关键事件部分，据报道，该部分将重要事件显示为药丸状快捷方式。如上面的第二个屏幕截图所示，该部分将显示在现有日历和颜色菜单上方。正如上面最后一张图片所示，应用程序的侧边栏也正在重新组织。现在，“立即同步”、“回收站”和“设置”选项似乎已重新定位到帐户列表上方。
更新后的三星健康提供了一些用户界面更改，但更大的新增内容是 Mindful note，这是一项新的应用内日记功能。该功能旨在为三星用户提供一个安全的场所来反思、记下想法并“捕捉瞬间、感觉或任何想到的东西”。
您可以选择从白纸开始，也可以根据提示获得一些想法，包括关于您自己、人际关系、工作和目标以及如果……会怎样？还有一个设置提醒的选项，如果您想养成每天写日记的习惯，这应该会派上用场。
上述更改仅在预发行软件中发现。这些可能永远不会广泛传播，即使广泛传播，它们的外观和功能可能会也可能不会如本文所述。

According to the announcement, these actionable insights use Gemini to analyze responses, uncover trends, and recommend next steps. With its ability to spot patterns, the AI is able to reveal how answers connect. And what’s an AI tool without summarization capabilities? Google says the tool will give you an overview of the key takeaways.

For example, if you create a registration-focused form, the tool will let you know who’s signing up. Or if you created a form for event feedback, the insights will let you know what respondents valued most.

The gradual rollout of actionable insights in Google Forms has started. It will be available to Google AI Pro and Ultra customers. Business, Enterprise, and Education customers are also getting access. Google warns that it could take up to 15 days for visibility.

cards.summary: 【NVIDIA】AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action. Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasonin…
fulltext: Share This Article
AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action.
Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task.
As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those steps quickly and support many agents at once, all within the limits of available power.

What this means: AI infrastructure providers need to support more agents without making each one wait longer to get work done. And critically, AI factories are power limited. This means operators need to choose infrastructure that maximizes the work done for every watt.

Why it matters: NVIDIA Vera delivers both fast agent performance and high capacity per watt within a single CPU. That gives providers one CPU for a range of agent workloads, rather than having to mix and match fast and dense x86 parts to balance speed and capacity.
The data that proves it: In a 100-megawatt data center comparison, NVIDIA found that a single Vera CPU performs better than the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU.
Partners are already putting Vera to work. Early adopters see the same exceptional performance in production-style tests:

cards.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
cards.title_cn: 用于交互式世界模拟的全新 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 开放模型
cards.summary: 【Hugging Face 官方动态】New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
fulltext: NVIDIA Cosmos world model development platform adds four new open-weight checkpoints to its Cosmos 3 model family for generating interactive world simulation and multi-sensor multi-view driving scenes:
All four models are post-trained examples of Cosmos 3 Nano and have 16B trainable parameters. The models use OpenMDW1.1, permitting commercial and non-commercial use under its terms.
Download the checkpoints · Read the technical report . Watch the demos

🦾 Robotics needs environments that can answer this across changing scenes and viewpoints. These checkpoints offer complementary ways to build them: Sim-Bimanual predicts visual consequences from actions, while Sim-Transfer turns a physics simulator’s controls into generated observations.

🚦 For autonomous driving, appearance and geometry must agree. Synchronized camera and LiDAR generation connects visual observations with 3D sensing. Scene and traffic-signal controls let researchers vary road layouts and signal states, then study how a driving policy responds.

🔄 Each observation can shape the next action. Streaming generation connects video prediction to ongoing interaction, giving world-model researchers a way to explore how actions and observations unfold together.

🌐 An open foundation for others to build on. NVIDIA’s vision is to help researchers and developers create richer, more responsive simulated worlds. Open weights and post-training recipes provide a shared starting point for adapting models, comparing methods, and contributing improvements. These problems remain hard: the work ahead is to measure where the models faithfully support policy learning and evaluation, understand their limits, and improve where they fall short.

Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto is a bidirectional model for offline synthetic driving data generation. It generates synchronized video across up to 11 camera views, including fisheyes, and supports joint RGB–LiDAR generation. Per-camera World Scenario Map (WSM) controls specify scene structure and traffic motion, while text prompts guide appearance.

Developers can vary environmental conditions to expand training and evaluation coverage, with optional initial RGB images to anchor scene appearance. Joint LiDAR generation additionally uses aligned HD-map range-map controls. Transfer-Auto also serves as the foundation for adapting Cosmos to your own sensor rig and driving domain. Start by post-training it on your data to accommodate your camera layout, LiDAR configuration, and target environment. The adapted model can be used directly for offline data generation or undergo causal training and few-step distillation for fast streaming simulation—the development path used to create Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto.
Point your agent to the open skill : Run inference with Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto
Prefer a notebook? Open Transfer-Auto.

Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto is the causally distilled streaming variant of Transfer-Auto. It generates successive small chunks of synchronized camera video and LiDAR in just a few denoising steps, using generated history and updated driving controls to support fast streaming and long, interactive rollouts.

Provide per-camera captions and synchronized WSM controls, optionally adding initial RGB images. For LiDAR generation, include HD-Map range controls aligned with the camera controls. The distilled model generates successive chunks using its rolling history. Closed-loop interaction requires a simulation runtime and WSM renderer to update those controls from driving inputs. For a new sensor rig or domain, adapt Transfer-Auto first, then distill it into Sim-Auto.
Point your agent to the open skill : Run inference with Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto
Prefer a notebook? Open Sim-Auto.
Your simulator computes motion, contacts, and physical state. Sim-Transfer uses its spatial controls and a text prompt to render color observations that a policy can consume.
Action → simulator update → spatial controls → generated RGB → next policy action
Depth: relative distance from the camera.
Segmentation: regions and object boundaries.
Edges: scene contours.
Blur: coarse appearance and layout.
Text guides appearance; physics and ground-truth state stay with the simulator.
Depth control to video
Segmentation control to video
Point your agent to the open skill : Run inference with Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer
Prefer a notebook? Use Transfer.
Input Frames
Output Video From Sim-Bimanual Simulation Checkpoint

Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual simulates how an environment evolves in response to a bimanual robot’s actions. It supports interactive two-arm simulation for YAM and AgiBot embodiments, controlled by a policy or human-operated joysticks.
Start with an image, move the robot or camera, and generate the next observations. One control sequence can switch between viewpoint changes and manipulation.

The mixed-action example uses 59 control values, padded to 64 during training. Its schema defines coordinate frames, rotations, gripper calibration, validity masks, and control domains. Follow those conventions so each value describes the intended motion.
Keep timing aligned: T transitions need T+1 observations. Training transforms raw captures into the model’s action representation; released inference actions are already normalized.
Here, Sim-Transfer generates visuals from a physics simulator’s updated state; Sim-Bimanual generates the next observation directly from the scene and robot actions.
See the data contract and action schema.

Requirements: Linux, an NVIDIA GPU, Docker, and NVIDIA Container Toolkit. The published vLLM-Omni setup was tested on one GB200; this is not a minimum-memory specification. The server downloads weights; the clients fetch sample inputs.
Point your agent to the open skill : Run inference with Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual
Prefer a notebook? Open Bimanual

Cosmos 3’s Mixture-of-Transformers backbone connects separate text-processing and visual-generation networks through attention. The generator predicts each short segment from the prompt, available controls, and generated history.
Controls + history → generate chunk → decode images → update history

Denoising refines noisy, compressed video representations into a segment. Temporal-causal attention lets it read available history and controls while blocking future target observations. A key/value cache retains attention information for the next prediction.

The model operates on compressed video representations called latents. After the initial image, each latent time step represents four RGB frames. Transfer predicts one step per chunk; the optimized Bimanual setup in the report predicts two. Smaller chunks let new controls affect generation more often.
Stage 0 — Bidirectional adaptation: learn the domain and its control-to-video relationships from complete recorded clips.
Stage 1 — Teacher forcing: predict each chunk from earlier recorded observations and available controls, with the clean answer and future targets masked out.
Stage 2 — Consistency distillation: use a frozen teacher to train a student that generates each chunk in four denoising steps.
Stage 3 — Self-forcing: train on the student’s generated history. A frozen teacher and an auxiliary score model supply the distribution-matching signal.

Why the final stage matters: a slightly mispredicted object becomes context for later frames, so errors can compound. Self-forcing exposes training to that generated history. Distillation and caching reduce the cost of producing each observation.

The post-training recipes start from Cosmos3-Nano or compatible base weights and cover all four stages. Keep full training checkpoints to resume; exported inference weights omit optimizer and other training state.
Transfer-auto: Post-train on your driving data to adapt to your sensor rig and domain, and generate offline synthetic data.
Sim-auto: Apply causal training and distillation to an adapted Transfer-Auto model for fast streaming simulation.
Sim-Transfer : Post-train the checkpoint for your environment with local data preparation, stage configurations, and resume.
Sim-Bimanual: Post-train for your embodiment with data validation, stage configurations, checkpoint handoffs, and export.

Give your coding agent the skill and dataset location. Follow the environment checks, validate a sample, and test training and restart before a longer run. Evaluate quality on held-out episodes: a successful short run verifies execution, not convergence.

cards.summary_cn: 【Hugging Face 官方动态】用于交互式世界模拟的全新 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 开放模型
fulltext_cn: NVIDIA Cosmos 世界模型开发平台为其 Cosmos 3 模型系列添加了四个新的开放权重检查点，用于生成交互式世界模拟和多传感器多视图驾驶场景：
所有四个模型都是 Cosmos 3 Nano 的后训练示例，并具有 16B 个可训练参数。这些模型使用 OpenMDW1.1，允许根据其条款进行商业和非商业使用。
下载检查点·阅读技术报告。观看演示
🦾 机器人技术需要能够在不断变化的场景和视角下回答这个问题的环境。这些检查点提供了构建它们的补充方法：Sim-Bimanual 预测动作的视觉后果，而 Sim-Transfer 将物理模拟器的控制转化为生成的观察结果。
🚦 对于自动驾驶，外观和几何形状必须一致。同步相机和 LiDAR 生成将视觉观察与 3D 传感连接起来。场景和交通信号控制让研究人员可以改变道路布局和信号状态，然后研究驾驶策略如何响应。
🔄 每一次观察都可以决定下一步的行动。流生成将视频预测与持续的交互联系起来，为世界模型研究人员提供了一种探索行动和观察如何一起展开的方法。
🌐 供其他人构建的开放基础。 NVIDIA 的愿景是帮助研究人员和开发人员创建更丰富、响应速度更快的模拟世界。开放权重和训练后配方为调整模型、比较方法和做出改进提供了一个共同的起点。这些问题仍然很困难：未来的工作是衡量模型在哪些方面忠实地支持政策学习和评估，了解它们的局限性，并改进它们的不足之处。
Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto 是用于离线合成驾驶数据生成的双向模型。它可在多达 11 个摄像机视图（包括鱼眼）中生成同步视频，并支持 RGB-LiDAR 联合生成。每个摄像机的世界场景地图 (WSM) 控件指定场景结构和交通运动，而文本提示则指导外观。

开发人员可以改变环境条件来扩大训练和评估范围，并使用可选的初始 RGB 图像来锚定场景外观。联合激光雷达生成还使用对齐的高清地图范围地图控件。 Transfer-Auto 还可以作为使 Cosmos 适应您自己的传感器装备和驾驶领域的基础。首先根据您的数据对其进行后训练，以适应您的相机布局、LiDAR 配置和目标环境。改编后的模型可以直接用于离线数据生成，也可以进行因果训练和快速流模拟的几步蒸馏——这是用于创建 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto 的开发路径。
将您的代理指向开放技能：使用 Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto 运行推理
更喜欢笔记本？打开自动传输。
Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto 是 Transfer-Auto 的因果蒸馏流变体。它只需几个去噪步骤即可生成连续的小块同步摄像机视频和激光雷达，使用生成的历史记录和更新的驾驶控制来支持快速流媒体和长时间的交互式部署。
提供每个摄像机的字幕和同步的 WSM 控件，可以选择添加初始 RGB 图像。对于 LiDAR 生成，包括与摄像机控件对齐的高清地图范围控件。蒸馏模型使用其滚动历史生成连续的块。闭环交互需要模拟运行时和 WSM 渲染器来根据驱动输入更新这些控件。对于新的传感器装备或域，首先调整 Transfer-Auto，然后将其提炼到 Sim-Auto 中。
将您的代理指向开放技能：使用 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto 运行推理
更喜欢笔记本？打开 Sim-Auto。
您的模拟器计算运动、接触和物理状态。 Sim-Transfer 使用其空间控件和文本提示来渲染策略可以使用的颜色观察结果。
动作 → 模拟器更新 → 空间控制 → 生成 RGB → 下一个策略动作
深度：距相机的相对距离。
分割：区域和对象边界。
边缘：场景轮廓。
模糊：粗糙的外观和布局。
文字引导外观；物理和真实状态保留在模拟器中。
视频深度控制
视频分段控制
将您的代理指向开放技能：使用 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer 运行推理
更喜欢笔记本？使用转移。
输入帧
Sim-双手模拟检查点输出视频
Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual 模拟环境如何响应双手机器人的动作而演变。它支持 YAM 和 AgiBot 实施例的交互式双臂模拟，由策略或人工操纵杆控制。
从图像开始，移动机器人或相机，并生成下一个观察结果。一种控制序列可以在视点变化和操纵之间切换。
混合动作示例使用 59 个控制值，在训练期间填充到 64 个。其模式定义了坐标系、旋转、夹具校准、有效性掩模和控制域。遵循这些约定，以便每个值都描述预期的运动。
保持时序一致：T 次转换需要 T+1 次观察。训练将原始捕获转换为模型的动作表示；发布的推理动作已经标准化。
在这里，Sim-Transfer 根据物理模拟器的更新状态生成视觉效果； Sim-Bimanual 直接根据场景和机器人动作生成下一个观察结果。
请参阅数据契约和操作架构。
要求：Linux、NVIDIA GPU、Docker 和 NVIDIA 容器工具包。已发布的 vLLM-Omni 设置在一台 GB200 上进行了测试；这不是最小内存规格。服务器下载权重；客户端获取样本输入。
将您的代理指向开放技能：使用 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual 运行推理
更喜欢笔记本？打开双手
Cosmos 3 的 Mixture-of-Transformers 主干网络通过注意力连接独立的文本处理和视觉生成网络。生成器根据提示、可用控件和生成的历史记录预测每个短片段。
控制+历史→生成块→解码图像→更新历史
去噪将嘈杂的压缩视频表示细化为片段。时间因果注意力使其能够读取可用的历史记录和控制，同时阻止未来的目标观察。键/值缓存保留下一次预测的注意信息。
该模型对称为潜在特征的压缩视频表示进行操作。在初始图像之后，每个潜在时间步代表四个 RGB 帧。 Transfer 预测每个块的一个步骤；报告中优化的双手设置预测有两个。较小的块让新控件更频繁地影响生成。
第 0 阶段 — 双向适应：从完整录制的剪辑中学习领域及其控制与视频的关系。
第一阶段——教师强迫：根据早期记录的观察结果和可用的控制来预测每个块，并掩盖清晰的答案和未来的目标。
第 2 阶段 - 一致性蒸馏：使用冻结的教师来训练学生，使其通过四个去噪步骤生成每个块。
第三阶段——自我强迫：训练学生生成的历史。冻结的教师和辅助评分模型提供分布匹配信号。
为什么最后阶段很重要：稍微错误预测的对象会成为后续帧的上下文，因此错误可能会加剧。自我强迫将训练暴露在生成的历史中。蒸馏和缓存降低了生成每个观察值的成本。
训练后配方从 Cosmos3-Nano 或兼容的基础重量开始，涵盖所有四个阶段。保持完整的训练检查点以恢复；导出的推理权重省略优化器和其他训练状态。
自动传输：对驾驶数据进行后训练，以适应您的传感器装备和领域，并生成离线合成数据。
Sim-auto：将因果训练和精炼应用到改编后的 Transfer-Auto 模型中，以实现快速流模拟。
Sim-Transfer：通过本地数据准备、阶段配置和恢复对您的环境进行后训练检查点。
Sim-Bimanual：通过数据验证、阶段配置、检查点切换和导出对您的实施例进行后期训练。
为您的编码代理提供技能和数据集位置。遵循环境检查、验证样本、测试训练并在长时间运行之前重新启动。评估持续事件的质量：成功的短期运行验证执行，而不是收敛。

cards.title: Samsung Android XR smart glasses pre-orders get started on November 12
cards.title_cn: 三星Android XR智能眼镜11月12日开始预订
cards.summary: 【Android Authority】TL;DR Samsung Android XR smart glasses are nearly here, with pre-orders now confirmed to open on November 12. The audio-based smart glasses, developed in collaboration with Google, will feature frames…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Smart glasses are about to enter quite possibly their biggest era yet, with the release of Google and Samsung’s new Android XR collaboration, and now we finally know when you can get your order in. The companies have been teasing these wearables for months now, featuring frames from the likes of Warby Parker and Gentle Monster. Last month we heard that a November launch was supposedly confirmed, and today pre-order details are starting to go official.
There’s not much to share just yet, but we do have a date: Pre-orders for Samsung’s “Intelligent Eyewear” open in one week, on November 12.

We’ve already seen the frames, and we know to expect an audio-first Android XR experience — Samsung models with integrated displays will have to wait. Recent rumors have suggested that the glasses will ultimately ship sometime in December, which would neatly fit with this pre-order window.

With any luck, next week’s opening of pre-orders will not just confirm that release date, but also finally reveal exactly what Samsung has in mind for pricing. That’s arguably the biggest outstanding question that’s been hanging over this launch. You won’t be paying anything like the $1,800 the bulky Samsung Galaxy XR headset runs, but these could still end up costing you as much as a decent phone.

Shoppers securing their pre-orders can look forward to using the smart glasses for help navigating around town, assisting with translations, or just chatting with Gemini to get information about whatever’s on their mind. They’re also equipped with cameras for recoding spontaneous moments — and yes, Samsung is taking all the expected privacy-preserving steps like lighting up an LED while recording and refusing to film if it detects the LED has been covered.

For as excited as we are to see these glasses finally land, it also probably couldn’t be happening at a worse time. Governments around the world are pushing back against smart glasses, limiting just how and where users are able to operate them. Ideally, regulators and manufacturers will eventually be able to meet in the middle with some mutually satisfactory compromise, but we’ll have to wait and see what shape that might take.
Are you planning to get your pre-orders in next week? Will you wait to hear more from early adopters before deciding? Let us know what you’re thinking, down in the comments.

fulltext_cn: Android Authority 上的附属链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解更多。
2026 年 11 月 5 日 — 中午 12:43（美国东部时间）
随着谷歌和三星全新 Android XR 合作的发布，智能眼镜很可能即将进入其最伟大的时代，现在我们终于知道什么时候可以收到订单了。几个月来，这些公司一直在嘲笑这些可穿戴设备，其中包括 Warby Parker 和 Gentle Monster 等眼镜架。上个月我们听说 11 月的发布已经确定，今天预购细节开始正式公布。
目前还没有太多可以分享的内容，但我们确实有一个日期：三星“智能眼镜”的预订将于一周内开放，即 11 月 12 日。
我们已经看到了框架，并且我们知道期待音频优先的 Android XR 体验 - 具有集成显示屏的三星型号将不得不等待。最近有传言称，这款眼镜最终将在 12 月的某个时候发货，这正好符合这个预购窗口。
运气好的话，下周开始的预订不仅会确认发布日期，而且最终会准确地揭示三星的定价想法。这可以说是本次发布中悬而未决的最大问题。你不会花 1,800 美元的价格购买笨重的三星 Galaxy XR 耳机，但这些耳机最终的价格可能与购买一部像样的手机一样高。
完成预订的购物者可以期待使用智能眼镜来帮助在城镇中导航、协助翻译，或者只是与 Gemini 聊天以获取有关他们想法的信息。它们还配备了摄像头来记录自发的瞬间——是的，三星正在采取所有预期的隐私保护措施，比如在录制时点亮 LED，如果检测到 LED 被遮盖则拒绝拍摄。
尽管我们很高兴看到这些眼镜最终落地，但它发生的时间也可能再糟糕不过了。世界各国政府都在抵制智能眼镜，限制用户操作智能眼镜的方式和地点。理想情况下，监管机构和制造商最终能够达成某种双方都满意的妥协方案，但我们必须拭目以待，看看会采取什么形式。
